html:
SMTO-CTX-0030 — A message you saved for this task is no longer available

GUID: edee6c0d-61dd-42a3-9e3c-199e6f3f20f3
Slug: saved-message-source-unavailable
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: context

What happened

  • One of the messages you saved to keep with this task can't be read anymore, for example because it was deleted. SMTO stopped before sending anything and did not bring back any deleted text.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Under the task, open Saved task context. Find the item marked Remove unavailable selection to continue and select Remove. SMTO won't send an incomplete set of saved messages, so the missing one has to come off the list.
  2. Continue the task, for example by selecting Resume if it's shown. Nothing was sent to the model before, so continuing doesn't repeat any work.
  3. If you still need that information, select Save to task context on another message that has it, or type the details into a new message. The original message can't be read, so the information has to come from somewhere still available.

What success looks like

  • Saved task context shows no unavailable items and the task continues.

If it still fails

  • If you think the message should still be there, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO so they can check whether it was deleted or its access changed. Don't try to restore deleted conversations just to clear this.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A selected saved task-context source (an assistant message) failed the ownership, deletion, eligibility or access checks during context preparation, so the next inference request was stopped (saved_message_source_unavailable); no deleted content was restored.

What this means

  • A selected assistant message cannot be read under the current ownership, deletion or source-access rules. The next inference request was stopped before sending an incomplete selection. No deleted content was restored.

Why this can happen

  • A selected source may have been deleted, its access revoked, or its indexed original may be missing.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect saved_message_ids, source availability and the context preparation status.

How to fix it

  • Use saved_message_ids in the error facts to remove the unavailable selections (Saved task context panel, or the DELETE route of the task's task-context/saved-messages API) before continuing. If the source should still exist, check its native_task_context_documents row, run membership, journal entry and access in skills/task_context/saved_messages.py source().
  • Open Saved task context, inspect the unavailable selection and remove it before Continue. If the source should still be available, investigate its retention and access state before retrying.

Retry and execution caution

  • The required permitted context can be included in full.

How to verify the fix

  • Inspect submitted context source identities.

What not to do

  • Do not silently truncate saved text or restore deleted content.

Technical notes

  • Saving and removal do not wake or restart the task.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0005 — Your request and the model's answer won't fit together
